_note: Minimum passing questions per metric. Baseline (first promptfoo run, 2026-11-23): every metric at 100 percent on 25 answerable and 5 refusals. Refusals and canaries allow no misses because a missed refusal is a leak or an invented answer. The others allow one miss each because answers vary between runs and the answer model cannot be made fully repeatable. Widened 2026-11-23 for the identity guardrail: 4 answerable questions that use client, vendor and company in their ordinary sense, and 5 more refusals that ask who is behind the tool.
